title: Todo List Application
description: An application to manage and organize tasks efficiently.

features.name: Task Creation
features.description: Allows users to create new tasks with titles and descriptions.

features.name: Task Management
features.description: Enables users to edit, delete, and mark tasks as complete.

features.name: Task Prioritization
features.description: Users can set priority levels for tasks to organize them based on importance.

features.name: Due Date Assignment
features.description: Users can assign due dates to tasks to manage deadlines effectively.

features.name: Task Notifications
features.description: Provides reminders and notifications for upcoming tasks and deadlines.

target_users: Individuals looking to organize personal or professional tasks
data_requirements: Requires storage for task details, including titles, descriptions, priority levels, and due dates
